invariants.rationale: The method consistently operates on result, invoking setters and passing it to another method, so it is expected to be non-null at exit.
result.setWriteStatuses(statuses) is always called in the method body with a presumably non-null List.
result.setPartitionToReplaceFileIds(...) is always called before return with the method result.
A List's size is always non-negative.
result.setWriteStatuses is called with a List argument.
